criteria: Integrate inventory -> ambiguity -> premise/proof -> independent design applicability -> compiler-derived initial compilation -> lint/retained assessment consumption. Mutate a source, decision or design revision and prove the downstream hold without lifecycle/Project mutation. No output asserts release.
material_failure_classes: Inventory, ambiguity and premise evidence must pass before design applicability and compiler-derived initial compilation.
A source, decision or design revision mismatch invalidates downstream applicability/readiness rather than reusing stale evidence.
Compilation and retained Agent Ready consumption remain separate typed boundaries and cannot bypass design applicability or lint/provenance.
Integration produces no lifecycle/Project mutation and cannot assert release.
non_claims: No release/execution admission follows from Wave 2A integration.
No Agent Ready implementation or rubric is copied.

candidate_custody.policy: Future PRODUCER pins contract/input/baseline/profile and candidate branch+full SHA; publishes candidate to configured authorized remote and records exact branch/SHA on the Issue before RESULT=VERIFY. Fresh independent verifier retrieves that exact SHA in its own worktree; retain retrieval and verdict receipts.
candidate_custody.closure: Retain actor-owned branch/worktree through required closure; disposition LANDED, DISCARDED or PARKED with durable blocker. No direct main push by a BIU worker.
candidate_custody.current_artifact: Candidate specification only; no Issue, branch publication, implementation commit or worker invocation created by Phase 12.

landing: SWF-19: merge exact accepted candidate SHA; no pull request.
stop_condition: Hold this BIU on unmet dependency proof, unbound budget/custody, authority gap/gate, source revision mismatch, unavailable evidence, failing discriminating probe or conflicting ownership. Preserve unrelated completed proof.
escalation_condition: Hold on failed integration discrimination, stale/missing source revision, or a genuine current authority conflict.
Do not reopen settled allocation, Agent Ready ownership, or historical edge-table questions.
readiness: Remain TASKS until all predecessors are DONE and fresh native Agent Ready returns READY; no release authority.
